tei:bibl.tei:title: Prayerbook for the New Year [First Day]
tei:bibl.tei:note: Digital imaging and document preparation: Aharon N. Varady; copy held by the HUC-JIR Klau Library, Cincinnati. The scan is the source. Independent reader: Claude Opus 5.5, medium reasoning. No translations have been supplied for passages absent from the English edition.

The scan prints directions without Kaddish words: reuse compatible Birnbaum Hebrew Half, Whole and Mourner’s Kaddish. The combined Shabbat/festival light blessing is also absent from this volume; its already printed Birnbaum option supplies that calendar variant. Retain credits/licence and provide no English fallback. The newly printed maḥzor Half Kaddish is a fixed Ten Days witness. Preparatory Elul29 Kaddish remains bound to compatible Birnbaum Hebrew, without importing its absent English; self-bind Birnbaum Kaddish components to preserve that choice.

tei:div.tei:head: Expanded Ashkenazi Mahzor
tei:div.tei:note: An editorial arrangement of the reviewed Heidenheim–Marmorstein passages. Digitization remains in progress.
החזן אומר מודים והקהל אומרים מודים דרבנן באותה שעה.
The reader says Modim while the congregation recites Modim derabbanan.

tei:div.tei:head: עירוב תבשילין
Eruv Tavshilin
tei:div.tei:note: When a festival is immediately followed by the Sabbath, food intended for the Sabbath may be prepared on a day of the festival only if bread and some cooked or roasted food (a piece of meat or fish) have been prepared and set aside for the Sabbath on the eve of the festival.
